assumptions.assumption: A 'long' rental period means rental_duration >= 5 days (5 is the cutoff, inclusive).
Films with NULL original_language_id form one group via GROUP BY, which keeps NULLs together as a single group.
Each group counts equally, so the outer AVG is an unweighted mean over groups; film_count counts all films in the group.
